name: prototype-planner
description: Plans the cheapest prototype that answers the question, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run prototype-planner", "plan the prototype", "what should we build to test this", "how do we test this cheaply", or an assumption needs testing and the team's instinct is to build the product to find out. Use it even for "we'll just build an MVP".
